name: Marketing Copy
tagline: Ads and sales copy that fit character limits and Brazilian advertising law
description: Takes the AI from briefing to final delivery of ads, posts, emails, SMS and WhatsApp messages: it gathers audience, offer, objection and proof, writes 3 to 5 variations per channel with the character count next to each text, and reviews everything against Brazil's Consumer Defense Code (CDC), the CONAR advertising code, the LGPD data protection law and the rules of professional councils and Anvisa (health, law, supplements, cosmetics). It delivers ready-to-upload tables, the list of what was changed and why, and a suggested A/B test. The knowledge base carries the rules with source and date, including the ban on fixed-odds betting in force since September 2026. Built for advertising aimed at Brazil: the legal checks apply Brazilian law only, although the writing method and the channel limits work anywhere. It is not legal advice, does not guarantee approval by a platform, CONAR or a council, does not promise sales results, does not write for purchased lists and does not write betting advertising.

packageContents: 3-step method with an exit checklist: briefing, writing and legal review
Character limits for Google Ads, Meta, email, SMS and WhatsApp, with the date they were checked
AIDA, PAS, BAB and 4U structures with ready-made examples per channel, already counted
Legal base with source and date: CDC, CONAR Code, 2026 influencer guide and LGPD (Brazil)
Advertising rules of CFM, COFFITO, CFO, OAB, Anvisa and betting (MP 1.394/2026)
4 ready-made templates: briefing, delivery table, legal checklist and A/B test plan
Calibration on first use: business type, channels, tone and available proof

steps.title: Briefing: audience, offer, channel, proof and restrictions
gate: Calibration profile checked and used to pre-fill the briefing, when one exists
Audience, offer and main objection confirmed with the user
Limit of each channel field noted from the limits knowledge base
Sector classified (ordinary or regulated) and mandatory identification noted
Each desired claim has proof at hand or is marked for removal
Blockers (betting, purchased list, therapeutic claim) handled or ruled out

steps.title: Writing the variations by channel
gate: 3 to 5 named variations per channel, changing one axis at a time
Each text with its count in parentheses and within the field limit
Structure (PAS, AIDA, 4U or BAB) declared and a single CTA per piece
No promise of results, superlative or urgency without proof
Brand tone and banned words respected

steps.title: Legal review, count and delivery
gate: Count redone and all texts within the limit
CDC, CONAR, LGPD and sector rules checked, citing number and year
Delivery in a table per channel, with status and mandatory identification
Changes listed: original phrase, new phrase and reason
User's open items and suggested A/B test
Disclaimer that the review is advisory and does not replace legal advice

sources: CONAR, Guia de Publicidade por Influenciadores Digitais (edição de maio de 2026)
Resoluções CFM, COFFITO e CFO e Provimento OAB 205/2021

Google Ads ad within the character limit
review my ad so it doesn't break Brazilian advertising rules (CONAR)
can I use before and after in my clinic's ad

beforeAfter.prompt: Write headlines and descriptions for a Google ad for my physiotherapy clinic in Campinas.
beforeAfter.withoutSolver: Headlines: 1. Quality Physiotherapy in Campinas with Experienced Professionals 2. End Your Pain for Good with Our Physiotherapy 3. The Best Physiotherapy Clinic in the Region. Description: Come to the best clinic in Campinas and say goodbye to pain forever with guaranteed results!
beforeAfter.withSolver: Headlines (max. 30 characters): 'Physiotherapy in Campinas' (25), 'Assessment within 48 hours' (26), 'We accept health plans' (22), 'Pilates and RPG in Cambuí' (25), 'Book on WhatsApp' (16). Descriptions (max. 90): 'Physiotherapy for spine and knee with a full assessment at the first visit.' (75) and 'Clinic in Cambuí since 2012. Individual 50-minute sessions.' (59). Paths (max. 15): /physiotherapy (13) /spine (5). I removed 'end your pain for good' and 'guaranteed results' (promise of results, prohibited by the physiotherapy code of ethics, Res. COFFITO 424/2013) and 'the best in the region' (superlative without proof: under CDC art. 38, the burden of proof is on whoever advertises). Before publishing, confirm the responsible physiotherapist's name and the CREFITO number for the landing page.

beforeAfter.prompt: A brand sent me a vitamin C serum and I'll earn commission with my coupon BIA10. Can you write the Reels caption?
beforeAfter.withoutSolver: Guys, I'm in love with this serum! 😍 In 7 days my spots disappeared and my skin turned into a different skin. Use my coupon BIA10 and get yours before it runs out! #skincare #vitaminc #loveit
beforeAfter.withSolver: First line, visible before the 'see more': '#publi I tested Brand X's vitamin C serum for 30 days. With coupon BIA10 you get 10% off until Sunday.' (102 characters, within the ~125). Also turn on Instagram's 'Paid partnership' label: a coupon commission is an advertising relationship, and the CONAR Guide to Advertising by Digital Influencers (May 2026 edition) asks for prominent, immediate disclosure that does not depend on the 'see more' (CDC art. 36). I removed 'my spots disappeared in 7 days': it is a result without proof (CDC art. 38) and a cosmetic cannot promise a treatment effect (Anvisa, RDC 752/2022). In its place, an honest account of use ('I use it in the morning, before sunscreen'). I also removed 'before it runs out': scarcity without real limited stock is misleading (CDC art. 37). Confirm the coupon's validity with the brand.

beforeAfter.prompt: I want to send a promotional SMS to my pizzeria's customers: large pizza with 20% off every Tuesday. Can you write a few options?
beforeAfter.withoutSolver: PIZZARIA BELLA: Hoje tem promoção imperdível! Pizza grande com 20% de desconto toda terça-feira! Peça já pelo WhatsApp (11) 90000-0000 e aproveite essa oferta incrível só para você!!!
beforeAfter.withSolver: No-accents option, to fit in 1 SMS of 160 characters: 'Pizzaria Bella: toda terca, pizza grande com 20% off. Peca no WhatsApp (11) 90000-0000. Resp SAIR p/ nao receber' (112). With-accents option, which limits the SMS to 70 characters: 'Bella: pizza grande -20% toda terça. SAIR p/ parar' (50). A single 'ç' or 'ã' drops the limit from 160 to 70, and the original version, with 183 characters and accents, would go out as 3 billed messages. I put the sender at the start and the way to stop receiving. The messages stay in Portuguese because the customers are Brazilian and that is where the accent trap applies. Confirm the contacts are customers who agreed to receive messages from the pizzeria (LGPD).

versions.notes: English becomes the primary language: method, knowledge base, templates and test cases were translated, and the Portuguese storefront text moved to locales/pt.json. The AI still answers in the user's language. The rating was measured again on this version (answers generated in English by an AI agent without seeing the checks).

Free trial: knowledge excerpts unlocked in the demo. The trial's knowledge search now returns excerpts from some files of each specialist (before, it returned none). The full knowledge base stays license-only; method, templates and answers did not change.

Moves to the Solver Package v1 format. New: calibration on first use (business type, channels, tone and proof), ready-made examples per channel with checked counts, legal checklist and A/B test plan templates, and steps rewritten with an objective checklist. The knowledge base gains source and date in each file, and the topics were split (health and law, Anvisa, betting, influencers). Fixes: the influencer guide does not mention hashtags such as #recebido, #parceriapaga or #conteúdopago and they were removed; dates and articles of CFM and OAB were checked against the sources. The previous 8 test cases stay the same and 10 new ones were added; the previous rating does not apply to this version and has not been redone yet.
Free trial with clear limits: what it unlocks and what only the license gives. End of pay-per-use: the specialist is now lifetime license only.

First public version: 3-step method (briefing, writing and review), character limits for Google Ads, Meta, email, SMS and WhatsApp, legal guide with CDC, CONAR, the 2026 influencer guide and LGPD, rules of CFM, COFFITO, CFO, OAB, Anvisa and betting (MP 1.394/2026), and briefing and delivery templates.
